 Luka Doncic proves himself right as Walker Kessler steps up without Austin Reaves 
 Luka knows. By Tyler Watts | Nov 9, 2026, 9:31 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Los Angeles Lakers, Luka Doncic. Mandatory Credit: Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Atlanta Hawks 124-114 behind 32-point game from Luka Doncic, but the superstar showed exactly why he’s been asking for a center since the blockbuster trade was completed. Number 77 knows having a rim protector, screen setter, and lob target improves his game. The Lakers didn’t have Austin Reaves in Atlanta, but still got the win because Walker Kessler stepped up.
--> The Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Atlanta Hawks 124-114 behind 32-point game from Luka Doncic, but the superstar showed exactly why he’s been asking for a center since the blockbuster trade was completed. Number 77 knows having a rim protector, screen setter, and lob target improves his game. The Lakers didn’t have Austin Reaves in Atlanta, but still got the win because Walker Kessler stepped up.
 Kessler finished with 21 points, 10 rebounds, four assists, one steal, and one block in 30 minutes of action. He made eight of his 12 field goals and went five of six from the free-throw line. The 7’2 big man kept getting buckets inside. He and Sandro Mamukelashvili helped make up for AR’s absence and get the Lakers their sixth straight win.
--> Kessler finished with 21 points, 10 rebounds, four assists, one steal, and one block in 30 minutes of action. He made eight of his 12 field goals and went five of six from the free-throw line. The 7’2 big man kept getting buckets inside. He and Sandro Mamukelashvili helped make up for AR’s absence and get the Lakers their sixth straight win.
 Luka wanted a center from the moment he arrived in LA. The Lakers traded for Mark Williams only for the deal to be rescinded by a failed physical. It took a year and a half before the Lakers could make the swing for Kessler. It cost them two first-round draft picks and two swaps, but Doncic knew it would make LA a serious contender and give them a shot to win every night.

 Luka Doncic is even better with a center

 The Hawks have elite perimeter defenders. They were using Dyson Daniels, Lu Dort, and Nickeil Alexander-Walker to slow down Doncic, but it didn’t matter. The Don still went off for 32 and dished out 10 dimes.

 Kessler has allowed Luka to take a step forward on defense. With a rim protector on the backline, Doncic can gamble more, and the Lakers are playing the perfect scheme for their superstar . Luka had five steals and two blocks against the Hawks, and he’s been outstanding on this end of the floor.

 Kessler doesn’t just make Doncic better.

 Reaves scored 43 points on Sunday night and looked like a star . The sat him with an illness on the second night of a back-to-back. The Lakers needed someone to step up, so Doncic fed Kessler.

He knows it. That is why he wanted the Lakers to acquire one. They've been outstanding since getting Kessler.

 The Los Angeles Lakers found out why Luka Doncic wanted a center. Walker Kessler has delivered, and nobody is thinking about the price. He had his third 20-point game of the season and looks like LA’s third star. There was no Austin Reaves in Atlanta, but it didn’t matter. The Lakers won thanks to Luka and Kessler.
